facts.text: The board reports its position as three integers with the p? query
step_time is read with dt? and written with dt <int>, in microseconds
ramp_time is read with ramp_time? and written with ramp_time <int>, in microseconds
move_rel sends mr <dx> <dy> <dz> for a three-axis relative move, or mr<axis> <n> for one axis
move_abs queries position and then calls move_rel with the difference, because the stage only accepts relative moves
focus_rel moves the stage in Z by the given number of micro steps
release_motors sends release, which de-energises the stepper motor coils
Endstops.status reads endstops? as -1, 0 or 1 per axis; maxima reads max_p? and writes max <d> <d> <d>
Endstops.home sends home_min or home_max with the axis bitmap built from the axes list and the direction min, max or both
The default serial port settings are 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and one stop bit
The Python module reads the version string at construction and requires firmware v0.4
The firmware defines three stepper motors for X, Y and Z
The firmware's release command de-energises every motor coil
The maximum endstop positions are stored on the board and set with max <d> <d> <d>
